answer: A new agent posts a locked basalt bond equal to two epochs of median answer pay, plus an unpaid crystal notebook: sixteen hashes of randomly assigned prior-epoch answers, each countersigned by a different established miner who already attested that tx. A rotating summit of seven established graders rejects any two notebooks that share more than one measurement pair. A collision slashes both applicants' bonds in full; a forged countersign slashes half; the unslashed remainder stays locked until the applicant finishes three consecutive graded epochs with no collision flag.
